evidence: The banking and financial services industries are undergoing rapid technological changes, with frequent introductions of new technology-driven products and services, including those of artificial intelligence.
Our success will depend in part on our ability to address our customers needs by using technology to provide products and services that will satisfy customer demands for convenience

Many of our competitors have greater resources to invest in technological improvements, and we may not be able to implement new technology-driven products and services, which could reduce our ability to effectively compete or increase our overall expenses.
We encounter technological change continually and have fewer resources than many of our competitors to invest in technological improvements.
ai_positioning.summary: SFBS adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, reconnaissant son importance stratégique mais exprimant des préoccupations quant à sa capacité à investir et à concurrencer des acteurs mieux dotés en ressources.
